verdict.rationale: Several items imply that Factory runs agents for you. Developers can start sessions in the Factory App on the web, assign Linear or Jira issues to Factory so Droid implements and tests the work remotely, and create and drive Droid sessions through a Sessions API. Droid Computers that retain state, offered alongside a 'Bring Your Own Machine' option, also suggest a hosted alternative, but no item explicitly states that Factory provisions and manages the cloud compute. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Factory-managed/hosted agent machines, details on cloud scaling or parallel execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
